title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Event group chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings
summary: The briefing's feature scope, Pro licensing, default state and published controls are supported. It accurately reports the conflicting Windows-only support statement and distinguishes government-cloud attendee-chat restrictions from this feature. The General Availability completion date should retain Microsoft's 'expected' qualification.

claims.quote: Chat privately with other event organizers, co-organizers, and presenters from an MTR console during an event in the event group chat.

claims.claim: Learn lists a limitation that Windows Teams Rooms with Pro cannot use chat when joining meetings as presenters.

claims.quote: This behavior occurs in Microsoft Teams Rooms for Android after you restrict the **Who can present?** meeting option to **Organizer and co-organizers only** or **Specific people** and is expected.

claims.claim: Android rooms also show an events-style interface when Who can present? is restricted to Specific people.
claims.quote: This behavior occurs in Microsoft Teams Rooms for Android after you restrict the **Who can present?** meeting option to **Organizer and co-organizers only** or **Specific people** and is expected.

claims.quote:
If you want to reproduce the events-style experience for testing, use these steps:

4. If needed, add the Teams Rooms resource account as a co-organizer.

claims.claim: Devices assigned a licence that lacks a feature cannot use it, so Basic rooms would need Pro for this chat.
claims.quote: If a feature isn't available for a license, that feature can't be used on Teams Rooms devices that have been assigned that license. To use a feature on a Teams Rooms device, assign the license in which that feature is available to that device.

claims.claim: No separate price for this private-chat feature is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "private chat" price meter licensing cap; read Microsoft Learn's Teams Rooms licenses and Android release notes. Results identify Pro entitlement, not a separate private-chat price.

claims.claim: No separate consumption meter for this private-chat feature is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "private chat" price meter licensing cap; read Teams Rooms licenses and Android release notes. No private-chat consumption meter was found; interpreter-agent consumption is a different release-note entry.

claims.claim: No feature-specific cap for this private-chat capability is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "private chat" price meter licensing cap; read Teams Rooms licenses, Android release notes and Manage chat for Teams events. No cap specifically for the new Android private-chat feature was found.

claims.claim: The cited documentation does not give the Teams Rooms Pro licence price.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "private chat" price meter licensing cap; read Teams Rooms licenses, release notes and the cited planning/chat pages. The licence comparison gives entitlements and purchase channels, not a numeric Pro licence price.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote:
1. In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to **Meetings** > **Meeting policies**.
2. Select the policy you want to edit.
3. Go to the **Meeting engagement** section.
4. Set **Meeting chat** to your chosen value

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled is a documented MicrosoftTeams PowerShell operation to disable meeting chat.
claims.quote: Due to a new feature rollout, in order to set the value of MeetingChatEnabledType to Disabled, you will need to also set the value of LobbyChat to disabled.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is a per-user and per-organiser policy.
claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to channel meetings and is a per-user and per-organizer policy.

claims.claim: The Meeting chat policy does not apply to channel meetings.
claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to channel meetings and is a per-user and per-organizer policy.

claims.claim: The documented general Meeting chat policy controls reading and sending chat in meetings and events with up to 1,000 attendees.
claims.quote:
As an admin, you can control:
- Whether participants in your users' meetings and events with up to 1,000 attendees can read and send chat messages.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly confirmed that the general Meeting chat policy governs this Event group or Planning group private presenter chat on Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "Android" "Event Group" "policy"; "Planning group" "Meeting chat" policy; "Event group" "Meeting chat" "off". Read Manage meeting chat, Manage event chat, Android release notes and MTR Support; none explicitly ties this private tab to the policy.
